مُبْرَمٌ : see بَرِيمٌ. ―
-b2- Also A garment, or piece of cloth, of which the thread is twisted of two yarns, or distinct twists. (S, K.) And hence, (S,) A certain kind of garments, or cloths. (S, K.) ―
-b3- [(assumed tropical:) A thing, or an affair, or a compact,
made firm, strong, solid, or sound; established, settled, or arranged, firmly, strongly, solidly, soundly, or thoroughly. See its verb, 4. ―
-b4- And hence, قَضَآءٌ مُبْرَمٌ (assumed tropical:) Ratified destiny; such as is rendered inevitable.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
